test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five boxes A, B, C, D and E are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. D is kept third from the bottom. Only one box is kept between D and C. There are only three boxes between B and C. E is placed immediately above C. How many boxes are placed between A and B?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Five boxes A, B, C, D, and E are kept one over the other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b317d06a4c6d705e5fba6d29123746b75338e6a385b4fe96f04b5575ba6a9b3a.png] 

 
• D is kept third from the bottom. ​

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fe10c98185f0b8ea534a80415a3b1f54bb819c50fc39e5e5f1a39c134a3d378.png] 

 
• E is placed immediately above C.
 
• Only one box is kept between D and C. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f19476214cdf1b5599954e313345072ae244e653e0d0e675bbc600c86c4595e.png] 

 
• There are only three boxes between B and C. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa4d01208b441dd08725527081612641dd73c748336f9a67d637677f8120206e.png] 

So, **0 boxes** are placed between A and B.

Hence, **the correct answer is '0'.**
